```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ maxTokens: 10, messages: [{ role: "user", user: { content: "Say hello in one word." } } as Message], model: "ollama/qwen2:0.5b" });
  console.log(result.choices);
}
```
